acceptanceCriteria: A fixture with a generated/oversized setup file and a registry lookup selects a bounded set, not ALL, when the file is readable within a stated bound.
Unreadable files still return ALL with the source-unreadable reason.
body: PR #1054 fix 2 makes setup selection return ALL when a setup file is tracked but not indexed (source-unreadable). Repos with generated or oversized setup files plus registry lookups therefore get ALL for registry-keyed specs: safe superset, lower precision.
title: tests setup selection: index generated/oversized setup files so registry-keyed specs don't fall back to ALL (PR #1054 residual)
